summary: This filing is a Form 8-K reporting a routine distribution to holders of asset-backed certificates issued by a structured product trust. The registrant, Structured Products Corp., provides notice of a July 1, 2026 payment of $1.025625 per $25 certificate, entirely in interest. There are no special-situations elements. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spinoff, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is indicated. It is a standard periodic distribution notification typical for a structured finance vehicle.
